# hivelocity_device_hardware (Data Source)

Returns the hardware inventory (drives, memory, RAID) of a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_device_hardware" "web" {
  device_id = 12345
}

output "web_drives" {
  value = data.hivelocity_device_hardware.web.drives
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the device.

### Read-Only

- `drive_count` (Number) Number of physical drives.
- `drive_types` (List of String) Distinct drive types present (NVMe, SSD, HDD).
- `drives` (List of Object) Physical drives. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--drives))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `in_raid_array` (Boolean) True when drives are members of a RAID virtual disk.
- `memory_slots_populated` (Number) Number of populated RAM slots.
- `memory_sticks` (List of Object) Installed memory modules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--memory_sticks))
- `virtual_disks` (List of Object) RAID virtual disks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_disks))
